conflict.tip: GitHub can't merge the branch into its base. Rebase needed.

changes.tip: at least one reviewer requested changes.

approved.tip: enough approvals under the repo's rules. Says nothing about QA or labels: check them before merging.

review.tip: not enough approvals yet, no changes requested.

tip.failure: CI red: at least one check fails
tip.none: No checks on the latest commit

toolbar.graphTip: One PR per card, grouped by stack. Key 1.
toolbar.listTip: Compact table, with the stack tree. Key 2.
toolbar.manualTip: Data only changes when you click ↻ or press R.
toolbar.autoTip: Polls GitHub every {every}, even while the window is closed to the tray.
toolbar.syncTip: Time of the last successful gh api graphql request.

rail.hideDraftsTip: Hides PRs marked as Draft on GitHub.
rail.rateTip: GitHub quota left this hour for gh api calls. The last sync of {repos} cost {points}.
rail.label: Filters

all.tip: All open PRs in the tracked repositories.

new.tip: PRs still highlighted because they need your attention (review to do, changes requested). The ones you hover or open here stay listed until you leave this view.

approve.tip: Other people's PRs you already reviewed that got commits after your review (or where your review was requested again).

requested.tip: PRs where your review is requested and that you never reviewed.

conflict.tip: Open PRs (drafts excluded) that GitHub cannot merge into their base without a rebase.

changes.tip: At least one reviewer requested changes.

summary.toApproveTip: PRs you reviewed that received commits since, or where your review was requested again

summary.draftConflicts: +{n} draft in conflict | +{n} drafts in conflict

forMe.approveTip: You already reviewed it: it received commits since, or your review was requested again.

drawer.conflictText: GitHub can't merge this branch. Rebase onto the base and push again.
